cloud_rule: Prefilter: granule CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE < 90 (whole Sentinel-2 tile, not the AOI). Acceptance: over the BWMA bounding box at 20 m, aoi_cloud_frac = count(SCL in {8,9,10}) / count(SCL != 0) must be <= 20%. The usable scene with the latest system:time_start is kept. Acreage is NIR reflectance < threshold on that single scene after masking SCL in {0,3,8,9,10} (no data, cloud shadow, medium cloud, high cloud, cirrus). This is not a 15-day median composite.
